en: This is an old postcard with three black-and-white photographic images: one of a school labeled 'Schule,' a panoramic village view labeled 'Totalansicht,' and a building labeled 'Gasthof Aug. Bartels.' There is German handwritten text below the images, and the printed phrase 'Gruss aus Herkensen.' The reverse side shows a postage stamp from the Deutsches Reich and is addressed to a person in Springe, with additional German hand-written script.
